name: Northern Lights Shopping Center

Shoppers tend to prioritize convenience and value, making quick trips for everyday necessities and household goods. The center draws from a broad age range, from young families to retirees, reflecting the established residential neighborhoods in the northern Syracuse area.
description: Northern Lights Shopping Center is a convenient neighborhood shopping destination located at 132 Northern Lights Plaza in Syracuse, New York. Serving the northern Syracuse community, this shopping center provides residents with easy access to essential retail services and everyday shopping needs. The center maintains regular operating hours from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, accommodating both daytime shoppers and those who prefer evening visits after work. Its accessible location and practical tenant mix make it a go-to destination for Syracuse residents seeking convenient shopping close to home.
